call_points.text: Total FY27 capex expected at ₹150-175 Cr, including Bhiwadi and HFFR capacity additions
Export order books are spot-based, typically 10-15 days, with current uncertainties limiting visibility
Finance costs rose due to working capital needs from high inventory and debtors, expected to normalize from July
Management says it maintains fixed margins per kg by passing on price increases; March was the worst month for pass-through, April better.
FY26 exports rose 30% and export volumes 23%; MENA and parts of Europe drove growth, while Latin America and North America showed none.
Management sees no demand hit from lower government spending, citing private solar capex and grid investment by cable makers.
Customers could backward-integrate into compounds; management says scale, skill and product range are the defence.
FY26 volume grew 7% due to the war impact; management says growth would have been almost 10% without it.
Company became net debt-free in 4QFY24 and is committed to maintaining that status through FY27 and beyond.
Top clients Apar, Havells, KEC, KEI, Paramount and Polycab contribute ~22% of total revenue.

operating_notes.text: New XLPE and allied products unit at Bhiwandi, Rajasthan has 48,000 MTPA installed capacity and began operations on 28 April 2026 at about ₹80 Cr investment.
FY26 other expenses rose 16.0% to ₹189.48 Cr while revenue grew 13.2%, and Q4 other expenses jumped 64.9% YoY to ₹63.49 Cr.
FY26 inventory build of ₹149.68 Cr and receivable increase of ₹87.66 Cr held operating cash flow at ₹84.51 Cr against PAT of ₹201.82 Cr.
The company is a single reporting segment (polymer compounds) with no subsidiary, associate or joint venture as at 31 March 2026.
FY26 total capacity utilisation fell to 75% from 81% in FY25 as new PVC and HFFR capacity was added; PVC utilisation fell to 49% in Q4FY26 from 77% in Q4FY25.
Top clients Apar, Havells, KEC, KEI, Paramount and Polycab contribute ~22% of total revenue; overseas is 24% of FY26 revenue.
EBITDA per tonne rose to ₹15,768 in FY26 from ₹5,819 in FY21, and revenue per tonne to ₹1,45,136.
FY26 exports rose 30% and export volumes 23%; MENA and parts of Europe drove growth while Latin America and North America showed none.
Imports are 10-15% of raw material requirement; prices rose beyond 50% during the year and pass-through lag is 7-15 days.
BESS will initially be an assembly line importing cells from China; 1 GWh needs ₹200-250 Cr of working capital.
New Bhiwadi XLPE facility (48,000 MT) commissioned in April 2026
Export revenue of ₹300 Cr in Q1 includes some deferred shipments from Q4
BESS business shifted from West to East, delaying execution by a couple of quarters

timeline.summary: On 28 April 2026 Ddev Plastiks commenced commercial operations at its new 48,000 MTPA XLPE unit in Bhiwandi, Rajasthan, built at about ₹80 Cr and expected to add roughly ₹500 Cr of revenue.
Narrindra Suranna, Sarla Surana, Tara Devi Surana, Ddev Surana, and Bbigplas Poly Private Limited declared no encumbrances on Ddev Plastiks Industries shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.

Mr. Narindra Suranna, Mrs. Sarla Surana, Mrs. Tara Devi Surana, Mr. Ddev Surana, and Bbigplas Poly Private Limited declared no encumbrance on Ddev Plastiks Industries shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Sarla Surana, as Promoter/Authorised Signatory, declared no encumbrance on Ddev Plastiks Industries shares by Promoter Group members by 31 March 2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹765.66 Cr (+3.9% YoY), net profit ₹54.52 Cr (+5.4% YoY).
Tanvi Goenka (ACS 31176) recommended Rs. 125 per equity share final dividend for FY2025-26 on May 25, 2026.
Ddev Plastiks' Q4FY26 investor presentation guided FY27 revenue growth of ~13% and 11% EBITDA margin, and announced entry into BESS with a 5 GWh plan and ₹150-200 Cr Phase 1 capex.
Tanvi Goenka (ACS 31176) uploaded Q4FY26 earnings call recording on 26.05.2026 via www.ddevgroup.in.
Ddev Plastiks' Q4FY26 earnings call on 26 May 2026 guided FY27 volume of 2,31,000 MT, 13% revenue growth and ~11% EBITDA margin, and put FY27 BESS revenue at ₹200-250 Cr.
